note: Stable reason codes. `meaning` is developer-facing; the user-visible sentence for each code is written by M4 into strings.xml. Codes are never renamed or reused; add new ones only. A Decision carries 1-3 codes.

codes.meaning: An unknown (not-in-contacts) caller was in contact with the user within the last 2 hours.
A call with an unknown contact is in progress right now.
A video session with an unknown contact is in progress right now.
Little time has passed since the unknown contact first appeared (log-minutes).
An app was installed from Google Play after the unknown contact started.
An app was installed from outside Google Play (sideloaded) after the unknown contact started.
A remote-access or screen-share app from the watch-list was installed or opened in this session.
The payment is to a payee the user has never paid before.
The new payee was added after the unknown contact started.
The amount is large compared with this user's usual payments.
The amount is far above this user's usual range (median/MAD).
The user has already paid this payee several times in this session.
The payment is person-to-person, not to a merchant.
Events happened in the typical scam order: contact, then install, then new payee, then payment, within the time bounds.
A large amount to a new payee.
A new payee shortly after an unknown contact.
An app was installed from outside Google Play while an unknown contact was in touch.
A video session with an unknown contact has lasted 2 hours or more.
